The value of `is` at line 34 is the same `is` that was assigned at line 14. The value of `os` at line 13 is the value that was assigned at line 13. These are independent assignments. The value of `is` used in the function call at line 34 does not depend on the value of `os` that was assigned at line 13. The `closeStreams` function receives both variables but the value of `is` is not constructed from or dependent on the value of `os`.
